description: This file defines the SupplierQuotation class and related functions for handling supplier quotations in an ERP system, including validation, status updates, and conversion to purchase orders or other documents.

classes.name: SupplierQuotation
classes.description: A class representing a supplier quotation, inheriting from BuyingController, with methods for validation, status updates, and related operations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the supplier quotation, including status, items, and valid till date.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Sets the status to 'Submitted' and updates related RFQ supplier status.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Sets the status to 'Cancelled' and updates related RFQ supplier status.

methods.name: validate_with_previous_doc
methods.description: Validates the supplier quotation against previous documents like Material Request.

methods.name: validate_valid_till
methods.description: Checks that the 'valid_till' date is not before the transaction date.

methods.name: update_rfq_supplier_status
methods.description: Updates the quote status of RFQ suppliers based on the current supplier quotation.
